Aisha: opened a PR to extend the 429 troubleshooting doc with a dedicated KV-cache section + an SDK-friendly example for graceful fallback. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1299
Luca: nice. can we include a short decision table: when to prefer prefix-only vs full replay? keeps readers from guessing.
Aisha: yes — added two bullets in the doc. prefix-first for latency/cost; replay when prefix miss or for critical consistency.
Sam: would be good to show a streaming-safe snippet that avoids double-generation if fallback happens. quick sketch below.
```python
# streaming with KV prefix + quick short-prefix fallback on 429
prefix = kv.get(session_key)
try:
    for tok in client.generate_stream(prompt, kv_cache=prefix):
        emit(tok)
except TooManyRequests:
    # short replay to fill the gap cheaply
    short_pref = prefix.truncate(12)
    resp = client.generate(prompt, kv_cache=short_pref, max_tokens=48)
    emit(resp.tokens)
```
